period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q3-2016 unaudited financial statements (clean digital pdftotext with scattered character-level corruption). Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used. TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY (33,279.02m) and TOTAL LIABILITIES (255,177.12m) are both directly legible; total_assets was not printed cleanly and is derived as their sum (288,456.14m), independently cross-validated by summing every asset-side line item (Cash, Balance with other banks, Money at call, Investments, Loans and advances, Fixed assets, Other assets, Non-banking assets), which reproduces the identical figure exactly. total_deposits was derived as Total Liabilities minus Borrowings, Subordinated Bond and Other Liabilities (223,495.03m), matching a surviving '223,495,...' fragment in the source. PAID-UP CAPITAL EVENT: this filing's own P&L shows a 'Dividend (Bonus)' appropriation within the Jan-Sep 2016 cumulative retained-earnings roll-forward, proving a bonus share capitalisation occurred on or before 30 September 2016. Combined with (a) this dataset's own 2016_Q2.json showing paid-up capital still at 17,177,199,240 as of 30 June 2016, and (b) a later filing (2017_Q3's own Statement of Changes in Equity) showing paid-up capital already at 19,753,779,120 as of 1 January 2017 -- exactly a 15% bonus on the June figure -- this pins the increase to Q3 2016 specifically. nav_per_share and eps_cumulative below use this inferred 19,753,779,120 paid-up capital (1,975,377,912 shares); both are therefore calculated rather than printed (the source's own EPS cell was blank). P&L cumulative figures cross-check cleanly: Net interest income (2093.04m) equals 2016_Q2's H1 cumulative (1282.83m) plus this filing's own discrete Jul-Sep 2016 NII (810.21m) exactly. Profit before provision (7338.56m) is not printed directly (the label's own row is blank) but is confirmed via TWO independent identity paths: Total Operating Income (11,366.40m) minus Total Operating Expenses (4,027.84m), and Total Provision (3041.16m) plus Profit before taxes (4,297.39m) -- both give 7,338,556,055 exactly. Interest income and interest paid are marked unavailable, the same persistent gap as every other quarter processed in this batch.
